name: Researchy Questions
description: Researchy Questions is a dataset of approximately 100k non-factoid, multi-perspective, decompositional questions derived from search engine queries. It targets challenging 'unknown unknowns' questions that require complex reasoning and decomposition, reflecting real user information needs beyond traditional factoid QA benchmarks.
reputation: A newly introduced benchmark for complex, non-factoid question answering that is primarily used in recent research rather than as a long-established community standard.
notes: Includes Clueweb22 URLs clicked by users; highlights challenges for GPT-4 and benefits of decomposition techniques.
